# What's the "no tax on tips" and "no tax on overtime" deduction worth?

> Free calculator for the federal 'no tax on tips' and 'no tax on overtime' deductions (2025-2028): applies the $25,000 tip cap, the $12,500/$25,000 overtime cap, and the shared MAGI phase-out, and computes the overtime deduction's easy-to-miss half-time-premium-only rule. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it answers

Two new federal deductions apply to tax years 2025 through 2028: up to $25,000 of qualified tips, and up to $12,500 ($25,000 married filing jointly) of qualified overtime compensation — but only the half-time premium portion of overtime pay, not your full time-and-a-half wages, and both shrink once your income clears $150,000 (single) or $300,000 (joint). This estimates both, including the part people usually get wrong. Source: 26 U.S.C. sections 224 and 225 as added by Public Law 119-21 (2025); married filing separately qualifies for neither. As of 2026-09-24.
